actual_execution: real amd64 Plan2001-O, 4 CPUs, TCG, native GE/O, virtio NIC

phases.V0: Current baseline had native GE/namespace/TinyCC tests but no TCP engine, native TCP ABI or interactive editor.
phases.V1: Native scripted editor and delegated TinyCC integrated in one running guest.
phases.V2: Ported IPv6 TCP engine and compiled HTTP/1.1 service with isolated object view.
phases.V3: Publication, compiler-error recovery, rollback, permissions, reboot and restore.

limitations: Scripted byte-oriented editor, not a graphical desktop or login system
Trusted bootstrap acts as Aino launcher; applications receive explicit restricted grants
HTTP supports GET and Connection: close only; isolated local IPv6 carrier, no TLS
Release rollback uses immutable ELF/source snapshot objects, not arbitrary storage time travel
Shutdown closes applications and commits the session; ACPI poweroff is not claimed
One pending GE writer per Space remains; no new storage or relation format

not_run.physical hardware: Only disposable regular-file disk images authorized
not_run.external TCP interoperability: UJ1 tests actual guest-to-guest-process IPv6 TCP on the same NIC identity; external peers/loss/fuzz/TLS are not claimed

regressions.name: Actual NS1/NS3 C bodies with ASAN/UBSAN
CBOR host sanitizers, vectors and fuzz
